ActiveSession.title: ActiveSession
ActiveSession.description: Tracks the student's current view, active unit, exercise index, and session counters for automatic reload and cross-device resume.

view.description: Current active screen in Estudio DSI.

unitId.description: Identifier of the active unit when view is study, or empty string otherwise.

exerciseIndex.description: Zero-based index of the current exercise or oral card within the active session.

sessionCorrect.description: Number of correct or mastered items in the active session.

sessionTotal.description: Total number of evaluated items in the active session.

oralMode.description: Active deck mode when practicing the oral mock exam.

oralQueueIds.description: Ordered list of oral question identifiers in the active oral mock session.

UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Cloud-synced study progress, error review queue, oral readiness ratings, active session location, and streak metrics for a single authenticated student.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning student.

completedIds.description: List of completed exercise identifiers across all units.

reviewQueue.description: Map of failed exerciseId to consecutive correct count (0 or 1; removed at 2).

oralRatings.description: Map of oralQuestionId to self-evaluated readiness level ('low', 'mid', or 'high').

bestStreak.description: Best consecutive correct answers streak achieved.

totalAttempts.description: Total number of evaluated exercise attempts.

totalCorrect.description: Total number of correct exercise evaluations.

activeSession.description: Current study session checkpoint for seamless reload and cross-device resume.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud progress update.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores isolated per-student study progress and active session checkpoint synchronized automatically across devices.
